logline: 계모 밑에서 궂은일만 하던 딸이, 잔치에 가는 길에 꽃신 한 짝을 잃는다.
destination: 고을 잔치 — 잃어버린 신 한 짝이 되돌아오는 자리
protagonist: 댕기머리에 무명 저고리를 입은 열여섯 처녀
setting: 조선 시대의 시골 마을과 고을 잔칫집
anchor: a Korean girl of sixteen, one long braid, plain undyed hemp jeogori and skirt
palette: hanji cream, ink-wash grey, persimmon orange, spring green, warm amber

kongjwi.label: 콩쥐
kongjwi.desc: a Korean girl of sixteen, one long black braid with a plain cord, patched hemp jeogori and skirt, bare feet

stepmother.label: 계모
stepmother.desc: a sharp-faced Korean woman in her forties, hair in a tight coiled bun, dark silk jeogori, jade ring

ox.label: 검은 소
ox.desc: a large black ox with wide curved horns and a broad wet muzzle

yard.label: 초가 마당
yard.desc: a beaten-earth yard before a thatched house, a stone jar row, a low wooden gate

feast_house.label: 잔칫집
feast_house.desc: a tiled-roof house yard set with low tables, hanging cloth banners, crowded guests

beats.visual: a sharp-faced woman pointing at a cracked water jar in a beaten-earth yard, a girl beside it
beats.motion: her finger jabs toward the jar, water runs out through the crack, dust darkens

beats.visual: a girl pouring water into a cracked stone jar in a yard, a puddle spreading at her feet
beats.motion: water pours down into the jar and runs out below, the puddle widens, dust darkens

beats.visual: a large black ox stepping through a low wooden gate into a beaten-earth yard
beats.motion: the ox walks forward through the gate, its head swings, dust lifts under its hooves

beats.beat: 처녀가 소가 물어다 준 것을 받아 든다.
beats.visual: a girl taking a bundle of cloth and small shoes from a black ox's mouth in a yard
beats.motion: the bundle passes into her hands, the ox's muzzle lifts away, dust settles

beats.visual: a girl in a fresh skirt and embroidered shoes walking a village path toward tiled roofs
beats.motion: she walks forward along the path, her skirt lifts at each step, dust rises behind

beats.beat: 개울을 건너다 신 한 짝이 벗겨진다.
beats.visual: a girl mid-stride in a shallow stream, one embroidered shoe floating away downstream
beats.motion: the shoe slips off and drifts downstream, water rings spread, her hand reaches after it

beats.beat: 잔칫집 마당에 신 한 짝이 놓인다.
beats.visual: a single embroidered shoe set on a low table in a crowded tiled-roof house yard
beats.motion: the shoe is set down on the table, banners flap overhead, the crowd presses in

beats.visual: an empty shallow stream over smooth stones at dusk, ripples spreading, reeds at the bank
beats.motion: ripples spread and fade across the water, reeds bend, evening light dims

withheld: 신 한 짝의 임자를 찾는 과정과, 계모와 팥쥐가 맞는 결말
